summary: Stood out before the event: air temperature at ~5.5 km, 30-day mean (exceptional: 2nd highest of 47 years); freezing level, 60-day mean (exceptional: 2nd highest of 47 years, medium confidence). Within the normal range: daily maximum temperature, snowmelt, snow depth, rain, earthquakes. Unusual is not the same as causal: these are candidates, not proof.
sources: Meteomatics Weather API (historic model and reanalysis data)
